observations: Prefix counts preserve original premultiplied channels; blended endpoints are integer-unpremultiplied and opaque.
Zero-alpha RGBA with preserved channels is recovered by the source opaque-8-bit fallback; NRGBA zero-alpha already loses those channels.
NoColor has opaque black RGBA channels but its symbolic style role differs from a known black input.
Nil filtering mutates the caller-provided variadic slice; reading the same changed slots through the source prefix shortcut is a code inference, not a separately executed observation.
limits: Native source calls only, no Rust RGBA16 constructor is implemented or claimed.
The explicit source image/color input is terminal style/color data; no image engine, decoder/codec or GPU code is involved.
Public-capability mapping, alpha-aware frame/geometry/hyperlink conformance and platform reproduction remain pending.
